overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board credibly did not anticipate the diner topic 48 hours before its May 31 meeting, and it added the topic to the notice promptly.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board added a non-emergency topic (a diner's food-license violation) to its May 31 meeting notice within 48 hours of the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing the diner during its May 31 meeting.
